curiosity.claim: Curiosity found chemical and mineral evidence that ancient Mars had environments that could support microbes. That is evidence of habitability, not proof of life.

ingenuity.claim: Designed to attempt up to five flights, Ingenuity completed 72. Its final flight was on January 18, 2024.

webb.claim: Webb’s 18 gold-coated primary mirror segments align to act as one mirror. The mirror structure folds for launch, then opens in space before alignment.

voyager.claim: Each Voyager carries a Golden Record with sounds and images of Earth, including spoken greetings in 55 languages. It is a time capsule of our world.

distance.claim: NASA projects Voyager 1 will reach one light-day from Earth on November 18, 2026.
distance.uncertainty: NASA projected milestone, rounded distance; not a current or live position.
